name: Ando
source:
A Curse Bearer who was one of the infamous "Thirteen Devil Children."

This axe-wielding maid used to be one of Matsuri's caretakers at the Benio Residence, but after chasing down Shiki with Kirishima, she ended up living with them at Maison sans Nom.

[From the [url=https://hanakimi.frontwing.co.jp/en/character13/]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]The grandmother of [url=/c146476]Ando Meme[/url].[/spoiler]
